verdict.score_rationale: The board lands at the 6 anchor because its detailed, readable regional composition and restrained semantic palette are undermined by large dead areas, sprawling ambiguous return routes, a clipped edge label, and unfinished shape vocabulary.

sub_checks.name: frame_use
sub_checks.note: The six numbered regions organize the canvas, but oversized lower and central containers leave broad empty bands while several flows are packed into the upper half.

sub_checks.name: color
sub_checks.note: Gray infrastructure/process forms, green success paths, red failure paths, blue audit storage, and the yellow explanatory note remain restrained, consistent, and legible.

sub_checks.name: machinery_leakage
sub_checks.note: Long dashed return loops snake across multiple regions and merge near the router, while a right-edge route label is visibly clipped, exposing routing mechanics rather than a fully resolved presentation.

sub_checks.name: alignment_and_rhythm
sub_checks.note: Panels and primary nodes mostly hold local registers, but uneven density, very long connector runs, and the plain rectangular 'Tokens emitted?' decision weaken hierarchy and operational-map vocabulary.
